description: Apply a colour effect (Effect > Color Correction or Utility) to layers, or to a new adjustment layer at the top of the composition so it affects everything below and final renders: Lumetri Color, Curves, Levels, Hue/Saturation, Exposure and other grading effects; Broadcast Colors to keep output broadcast-safe; Color Profile Converter to simulate an output type in renders. Set controls by display name with properties

adjustmentLayer.description: Apply to a new adjustment layer spanning the composition, at the top

broadcastMethod.description: broadcast_colors: How To Make Color Safe

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layerName.description: Name of the new adjustment layer. Default: the effect name

layers.description: Apply to these layers. Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true. Omit with adjustmentLayer: true

properties.description: Control display names to values (numbers, arrays, booleans; menus take their 1-based item number), e.g. { "Exposure": 0.5 }

name: apply_color_effect
title: Apply Color Effect
